xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3418: Empty-string conversation model is stored, never backfilled, and blanks the harness+model chips (conv 1794 silently ran Opus 5)

plan.title: Empty-string conversation model is stored, never backfilled, and blanks the harness+model chips
plan.author: agent:k3[1m]

narratives.Problem: A conversation created with model='' (empty string) is permanently wrong: the Command Deck row loses both harness and model chips, and the boot-time backfill can never repair the row because its SQL predicate only matches model IS NULL. Conv 20260801-7889 (conv 1794) silently ran 222/222 assistant turns on claude-opus-5 with no --model flag and no record. 5 live host rows are stuck this way. Four hops cooperate: the frontend fallback default is legitimately '', CommandDeck captures it at mount and never re-seeds after the real model list loads (a last-used model outside the hardcoded FALLBACK_GROUPS fails validation and blanks), the route keeps '' as a supplied value, and the write door's ?? only guards null/undefined.
narratives.Proposal: Fix each hop in the live code path: (1) handleConversationCreate coerces empty/whitespace model+effort to undefined; (2) the conversation write door (src/lib/overdeck/conversations.ts — NOT the production-dead conversations-db.ts the issue cites) stores NULL via a nullIfEmpty helper; (3) backfillConversationModel widens to (model IS NULL OR model = '') so broken rows self-heal from their transcripts at next dashboard boot; (4) ModelPicker re-seeds its selection via onChange after the real model list resolves, gated on !liveConversation; (5) ConversationRow renders the harness chip independently of the model. The 5 existing broken rows heal through the widened backfill post-deploy (no hand-rolled UPDATEs), verified by a read-only sweep. Each implementation item carries its own regression tests.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No hardcoded conversation-model default anywhere; a model-less conversation stays NULL and its actual model is recorded by the backfill
- No changes to the production-dead src/lib/database/conversations-db.ts duplicate
- No rejection of model-less conversation creation (operators may deliberately use their CLI default)
- No auto-switching of a running conversation's model — the picker re-seed is gated on !liveConversation
- The missing cost/token figures on young conversation rows (enrichment fills them in later; excluded by the issue)
- extractModelFromSessionFile first-assistant-model semantics are unchanged; mid-session model switches are out of scope

metadata.docsJustification: Bug fix to conversation model/effort storage, backfill, and Command Deck rendering; no user-facing documented surface describes this behavior (verified 2026-08-01: grep of docs/, configuration/, reference/ for backfillConversationModel and default_conversation_model finds only a historical investigation note, docs/overdeck-remodel/investigations/conversations-transcripts-audit.md).

autoDecisions.summary: Fix the live write door src/lib/overdeck/conversations.ts, not the issue-cited src/lib/database/conversations-db.ts
autoDecisions.rationale: The cited module has zero production consumers (git grep + the header comment of tests/unit/lib/database/conversation-workspace-linkage.test.ts confirm); fixing dead code changes nothing in production.

autoDecisions.summary: Re-seed the picker from inside ModelPicker via onChange (the issue's option A), gated on !liveConversation
autoDecisions.rationale: The picker alone knows when its fetch settled and what knownModelIds became; CommandDeck would have to guess the timing. The liveConversation gate prevents auto-switching a running session's model.

autoDecisions.summary: Satisfy 'never spawn silently' by recording the model the harness used (widened backfill), not by failing loudly
autoDecisions.rationale: Operators may deliberately create model-less conversations to use their personal CLI default; rejecting them breaks a legitimate flow. The widened backfill records the actual model from the transcript, and the picker re-seed means new conversations practically always carry an explicit model.

autoDecisions.summary: Repair the 5 existing broken rows through the widened backfill at next dashboard boot post-deploy
autoDecisions.rationale: backfillConversationModel is the write door; hand-rolled UPDATEs are forbidden. The backfill already probes !conv.model rows, so widening its predicate heals every resolvable row automatically.

autoDecisions.summary: Apply the same ''-coercion to effort as to model; harness needs none
autoDecisions.rationale: effort shares the identical store-and-never-heal shape (its SAFE_EFFORT_PATTERN guard is falsy-skipped by ''); harness is validated against the allowed set by resolveAllowedHarness.

autoDecisions.summary: Fold regression tests into their implementation items, one new test file per backend item
autoDecisions.rationale: Tracer-bullet slices carry their own tests; separate new test files avoid parallel-edit conflicts between items 2 and 3 which both touch src/lib/overdeck/conversations.ts.

items.title: Coerce empty/whitespace model and effort to undefined at the conversation-create route

expected_outputs: new test file passes: createConversation receives model: undefined and effort: undefined for empty-string request fields

narrative.Action: In handleConversationCreate (src/lib/overdeck/conversation-runtime.ts:885-886), coerce an empty/whitespace-only model and effort to undefined after trim (e.g. body['model'].trim() || undefined), so an empty request field behaves identically to an omitted one. Add tests/unit/lib/overdeck/conversation-runtime-empty-model.test.ts: vi.mock the conversations module (capture createConversation opts; stub getConversationByName to null) and the event-store module (emitOnly stub); call handleConversationCreate with model: '' and effort: '  ' and assert createConversation received undefined for both. Assert only on the synchronous createConversation call — the background spawn IIFE catches its own errors.

items.title: Given a POST body with model: '', when handleConversationCreate runs, then createConversation receives model: undefined
Given a POST body with effort: '   ' (whitespace-only), when handleConversationCreate runs, then createConversation receives effort: undefined
Given a POST body with a real model id, when handleConversationCreate runs, then createConversation still receives that model id unchanged
Conversation write door stores NULL (never '') for model and effort

expected_outputs: new test file passes: empty/whitespace model and effort persist as NULL; real values persist unchanged

narrative.Action: In src/lib/overdeck/conversations.ts add a module-local helper nullIfEmpty(value: string | undefined): string | null (trim; empty → null) and apply it to model and effort in createConversation (lines 1233-1234, replacing opts.model ?? null / opts.effort ?? null) and to model in reactivateConversationForSpawn (line 1294). This is defense-in-depth at the write door so no caller can ever store ''. Add tests/unit/lib/overdeck/conversations-empty-model.test.ts using setupOverdeckTestDb() from tests/helpers/overdeck-test-db.ts (pattern: tests/unit/lib/database/conversation-workspace-linkage.test.ts). Do NOT touch the production-dead src/lib/database/conversations-db.ts.

items.title: createConversation with model: '' persists NULL, observable via getConversationByName(name).model === null
createConversation with whitespace-only model and with effort: '' persists NULL for both fields
createConversation with model: 'k3' persists 'k3' unchanged
reactivateConversationForSpawn with model: '' stores NULL in the conversations row
Widen backfillConversationModel to repair empty-string model rows

expected_outputs: new test file passes: a row seeded with model='' is repaired; a row with a real model is not overwritten

narrative.Action: In src/lib/overdeck/conversations.ts:1375-1377 change the predicate to UPDATE conversations SET model = ? WHERE name = ? AND (model IS NULL OR model = '') and update the doc comment (no longer 'only when currently NULL'). The probe in backfillConversationModels (src/lib/overdeck/conversation-runtime.ts:469) already selects !conv.model rows, so no change is needed there. Add tests/unit/lib/overdeck/conversations-model-backfill.test.ts (setupOverdeckTestDb pattern): create a conversation with a real model, force its row to '' via the test DB handle, call backfillConversationModel, assert the model is now the backfilled value; second case asserts a non-empty model is never overwritten.

items.title: Given a conversations row with model = '', when backfillConversationModel(name, 'claude-opus-5') runs, then the row persists 'claude-opus-5'
Given a conversations row with a non-empty model, when backfillConversationModel runs with a different model, then the row preserves its original model
ConversationRow renders the harness chip independently of model presence

expected_outputs: new render test passes: harness chip visible with model null; both chips visible with a model present

narrative.Action: In src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/CommandDeck/ConversationRow.tsx:400-407, lift the harness chip out of the {conv.model && (...)} guard so it renders unconditionally (with the existing conv.harness ?? 'claude-code' fallback), keeping the separator + model chip gated on conv.model. Match the surrounding separator conventions. Add src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/CommandDeck/__tests__/ConversationRow.test.tsx (pattern: sibling ConversationList.test.tsx) rendering a conversation with model: null and one with a model.

items.title: Given a conversation with model null and harness 'claude-code', when ConversationRow renders, then it displays the harness chip and no model chip
Given a conversation with model 'k3', when ConversationRow renders, then it displays both the harness chip and the model chip
ModelPicker re-seeds the new-conversation selection after the real model list resolves

expected_outputs: ModelPicker tests pass: onChange fires with the stored non-FALLBACK model after the mount fetch; no onChange from the effect when liveConversation is true

narrative.Action: In src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/chat/ModelPicker.tsx loadModels() (mount effect, lines 204-291), after syncKnownModels(effectiveGroups) and settings resolution, add a re-seed gated on !liveConversation: compute resolved = loadStoredModel(getDefaultConversationModel()); if resolved is truthy, differs from the mount-time value prop, and isKnownModel(resolved), call onChange(resolved, effortLevels of the matching model in effectiveGroups, defaulting to []). This is safe against clobbering a user pick made during the fetch because the parent persists every pick via saveStoredModel, so loadStoredModel returns the fresh pick and the onChange becomes a no-op. Extend src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/chat/__tests__/ModelPicker.test.tsx: mock the four fetch endpoints the effect calls, seed localStorage 'conv-composer-model' with a model absent from FALLBACK_GROUPS but present in the mocked available-models response, render with value="" and assert onChange eventually receives that model; second case asserts no effect-driven onChange when liveConversation is true.

items.title: Given localStorage holds a model absent from FALLBACK_GROUPS but present in the fetched list, when the mount fetch resolves, then the picker calls onChange with that model id
Given liveConversation is true, when the mount fetch resolves, then the effect never calls onChange
Given no stored model and no configured default, when the mount fetch resolves, then the picker does not call onChange (empty stays empty — no hardcoded default)
Post-deploy: verify the 5 broken host rows healed through the backfill

verify_commands: node -e "const { DatabaseSync } = require('node:sqlite'); const db = new DatabaseSync(process.env.HOME + '/.overdeck/overdeck.db', { readOnly: true }); console.log(db.prepare(\"SELECT name, model FROM conversations WHERE name = '20260801-7889'\").all()); console.log('empty-string rows:', db.prepare(\"SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM conversations WHERE model = ''\").get().n); db.close();"
expected_outputs: empty-string row count is 0, or every remaining row is listed with an unresolved reason in an issue comment

narrative.Action: After this issue merges and the dashboard redeploys (the boot triggers startConversationModelBackfill at src/dashboard/server/routes/conversations.ts:188), run the read-only node:sqlite sweep from verify_commands. Confirm conversation 20260801-7889 (conv 1794) now reads claude-opus-5 and zero model='' rows remain. The 5 known broken rows are 20260801-7889, 20260726-3088, 20260720-9741, 20260709-1871, 20260624-1015. If any row remains unresolved (transcript unreadable or no assistant message), comment the row name and reason on PAN-3418 — never guess a model, never hand-roll an UPDATE. This item touches no code; it cannot run before deploy.

items.title: Post-deploy read-only sweep shows conversation 20260801-7889 with model 'claude-opus-5'
Post-deploy read-only sweep returns zero conversations rows with model = '', or every remainder is logged with a reason in an issue comment
